dict.string: skil.li runs the Mac commands you ask for: dark mode, empty the Trash, restart.
skil.li shows your next meeting and joins it in one key, and answers “qu'est-ce que j'ai demain ?”. Your calendars stay on this Mac.
skil.li shows your next meeting and joins it in one key, and answers “qu'est-ce que j'ai demain ?”. Your calendars stay on this Mac.
skil.li finds the people you ask for (“@jean”, “qui est Jean-François de chez Lumière ?”) and writes to them. Your contacts stay on this Mac.

skil.li listens when you use Ask by Voice (✦V) or Dictate (✦D), records your side of a meeting when you record one, and shows your microphone's level when you check it before a meeting; speech is turned into text on this Mac.
skil.li records the Mac's sound, the others in a call, when you record a meeting; it is transcribed on this Mac and sent nowhere.
skil.li shows you your camera when you press Check Camera & Mic in a meeting's card, before you join. Nothing is recorded.
skil.li connects and disconnects the Bluetooth devices paired with this Mac (AirPods, a keyboard, a speaker) when you ask it to.
skil.li turns what you say to Ask by Voice (✦V) or Dictate (✦D), and the meetings you record, into text, on this Mac.
skil.li adds reminders when you ask it to, from Ask or a command with the Reminders tool.
